name: WebDevOps Restaurant Menu Sync for Toast
author: webdevopspvtltd

sections.description:
WebDevOps Restaurant Menu Sync for Toast connects to the Toast POS platform’s API and synchronizes menu groups, menu items, modifiers, and images into your WordPress site. This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Toast, Inc.
Features include:
* Automatic menu sync
* Modifier sync
* Menu group hierarchy sync
* Real-time updates via webhook
* Shortcodes & display tools
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/webdevops-restaurant-menu-sync-for-toast/.
  2. Activate it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Toast Menus in the admin menu.
  4. Enter your Toast API credentials.
  5. Run “Sync Menu”.
sections.faq:
What does Restaurant Menu Sync for Toast do?

It connects your Toast POS account to your WordPress website and automatically syncs your menu, including categories, items, descriptions, prices, modifiers, and images. This ensures your website always matches what’s in Toast without any manual editing.

Does it work with any Toast plan?

Yes. It works with Toast POS accounts that have Partner API access enabled. If you’re not sure whether your account has this, contact your Toast representative to confirm.

Is WooCommerce required to use this plugin?

No. The plugin works independently to sync and display your Toast POS menu. WooCommerce is not required.

How often does the menu sync with Toast?

The plugin syncs automatically in real time whenever you make changes in Toast, such as adding menu items, updating prices, changing descriptions, or marking items as unavailable. You can also trigger a manual sync from the WordPress admin at any time.

Can I customize how the menu looks on my website?

Yes. The plugin includes six professionally designed, responsive templates along with customization options for colors, fonts, layouts, and image placement, allowing you to match your restaurant’s branding.
